narr: Training convection ahead of a cold front resulted in bands of heavy rain in a short period of time and a couple of reports of flash flooding. The heaviest amounts of 5 to 8 inches fell in a swath from Franklin county northeastward to Jefferson county.
ev: Water around 6 inches deep reached the rims of tires near Highway 22 and Cherry Street as well as Bob Little Road due to heavy rainfall of a few inches in a short period of time.
Highway 19 north of the railroad bridge was temporarily closed due to flooding from heavy rain of 5-8 inches in a short period of time.
lsr: REPORT OF US-19 NORTH OF RAILROAD BRIDGE UNDERWATER.
WATER AROUND 6 INCHES DEEP REACHING THE RIMS OF TIRES NEAR HIGHWAY 22 AND CHERRY STREET AND BOB LITTLE ROAD.
